One of this award season’s last remaining categorization questions has been answered: The Hollywood Reporter can exclusively report that just ahead of today’s Golden Globes submission deadline, Artificial , Luca Guadagnino ’s hot-button portrait of the rise of artificial intelligence, has been entered by Neon for Globes consideration in the musical/comedy categories, as opposed to the drama races.
This move means that the film — which Amazon/MGM dropped, allegedly out of fear of angering tech bros portrayed in it including OpenAI co-founders Sam Altman and Elon Musk, but which Neon subsequently picked up and has screened to rave reviews — will compete for a best picture Globe against the likes of Wild Horse Nine , The Invite , The Debut , Obsession , Club Kid , Project Hail Mary and Tender Loving Care , as opposed to The Odyssey , La Bola Negra , Dune: Part Three , Elsinore , All of a Sudden , Fjord , I Play Rocky and Possible Love . The only other category that this classification will impact is the best actor race, in which Yura Borisov , who portrays Ilya Sutskever, OpenAI’s co-founder, is competing, and will now be competing against the likes of John Malkovich ( Wild Horse Nine ), Ryan Gosling ( Project Hail Mary ), Jordan Firstman ( Club Kid ), Seth Rogen ( The Invite ) and Tom Cruise ( Digger ), rather than Andrew Scott ( Elsinore ), Matt Damon ( The Odyssey ), Robert Pattinson ( Primetime ), Anthony Ippolito ( I Play Rocky ), Sebastian Stan ( Fjord ) and John Turturro ( The Only Living Pickpocket in New York ).
The film’s strongest awards prospect is probably Andrew Garfield , who gives a tour de force turn as Altman, and who will compete in the genre-blending supporting actor race. Monica Barbaro , also excellent in the film as OpenAI chief technology officer Mira Murati, will be up for best supporting actress.
Many expected Artificial to be entered for the Globes as a drama, given that it deals frankly with concerns that artificial intelligence has grown out of control. (Its closest comp is probably 2010’s The Social Network , another very dark but also funny tech-centric film, which competed as a drama and won four awards, including best picture.)
But there is certainly a legitimate argument that Artificial , which had its world premiere at the New York Film Festival on Oct. 5, is a comedy. Indeed, it was written by noted New Yorker humorist Simon Rich, who has also written for Saturday Night Live and The Simpsons ; and elements of the film have evoked audible laughter in screenings, including Sutskever’s idiosyncracies (repeating his name three times, telling colleagues that AGI would come “Not in your lifetime – due to your advanced ages,” etc.) and Ike Barinholtz’s portrayal of Musk.
THR recently broke the news of one of the year’s other most notable Globes category submissions: Obsession being entered as a musical/comedy, rather than a drama.
The 84th Golden Globe Awards will take place on Jan. 10, 2027.
